The discount is a proposal pending manager and owner approval, and restocking is not yet confirmed.

Campus Customs

Hi Yale AI Club,

For 20 size M Basic Hoodie Big Yale hoodies, I can propose a 10% bulk discount: $52.20 per hoodie, $1,044 total. This modest discount keeps the price well above our $22 unit cost. We currently have 8 available at Aisle A; the remaining 12 require restocking. The vendor cannot accept a restock order until an existing approval/payment step is resolved, so the earliest possible arrival is September 5, 2026 if that clears today and a restock is then placed (an estimate, not a promise). We can discuss the 8 currently on hand with the remaining 12 later, or the full order after restock. The discount is a proposal pending manager and owner approval, and restocking is not yet confirmed.

Campus Customs

Campus Customs
